Package org.uma.evolver.meta.builder

Class ComputingTimeLimit

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.meta.builder.ComputingTimeLimit
public final class ComputingTimeLimit extends Object
Computing-time limit of a meta-optimizer, the alternative to the limit on the number of meta-evaluations. The two limits are mutually exclusive: a meta-optimizer is bounded by one or the other.

The limit is given in minutes, with decimals (for example 0.5). It is checked at the beginning of each iteration of the algorithm, so the generation in progress when the limit is reached is always completed (the real time can exceed the limit by up to one generation), and the initial population is always evaluated, even if that takes longer than the limit. The asynchronous meta-optimizers have no generations: they use asynchronousTermination(double, int), checked after every evaluation.
